title: Rename the domain StreakEvent so it stops colliding with Drift's generated StreakEvent row class

evidence.quote: class StreakEvent extends DataClass implements Insertable<StreakEvent> {

/// Distinct from Drift's row class (also called `StreakEvent` and
/// generated from `tables/streak_events.dart`): this one is what the

why: Two unrelated public top-level classes share the name StreakEvent: the hand-written domain value type that streak_event_test.dart exercises, and Drift's generated row class. It's self-aware (the domain class's own doc comment explains the collision) and worked around with `hide StreakEvent` at the one call site needing both today, but every future file that needs both the Drift row and the domain value is one missing hide/alias away from a confusing 'wrong StreakEvent' type error, and the name can't be used unqualified in review comments, Linear tickets, or docs.
recommendation: Rename the domain class (e.g. StreakLogEvent) -- it's the smaller of the two and all its call sites are internal to the streak feature.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -rn 'class StreakEvent' learning_tracker/lib/` returns exactly one hand-written match plus the Drift-generated one, under distinguishable names.

corrections: Core collision (both class-definition lines, doc-comment self-awareness) verified exact. But the recommendation's claim 'all call sites internal to the streak feature' is false: core/sync/merge/streak_event_merger.dart also imports+hides the domain StreakEvent, a third site outside the feature dir. This strengthens rather than undercuts the case for renaming; only the scope claim needs correction.

Finding says 'the one call site needing both today' but grep shows 4 files already import both and hide the Drift StreakEvent (streak_event_log.dart, streak_restorer.dart, streak_event_merger.dart, streak_state_provider.dart) — an undercount that if anything strengthens rather than weakens the finding.

mergedFrom: StreakEvent domain class name collides with the Drift-generated StreakEvent row class
